<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/ -->

# Build with Yep

Send a search request or connect an MCP client in a few minutes.

## Choose an integration

Use the Search API when your application needs ranked web results over HTTP. Use the Agent API when Yep should turn a prompt into a sourced report with your model provider key. Use MCP when an AI client should choose and call Yep tools through OAuth.

## Send your first request

Create an API key in the product and move the creation-response secret directly into the
`YEP_API_KEY` environment variable. Then choose one runnable example:

```curl
curl --get 'https://yep.com/api/v1/search' \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'query=carbon border tax 2026' \
  --data-urlencode 'limit=5'
```

```typescript
const url = new URL("https://yep.com/api/v1/search");
url.search = new URLSearchParams({ query: "carbon border tax 2026", limit: "5" }).toString();
const response = await fetch(url, {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.YEP_API_KEY}` },
});
if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Yep API returned ${response.status}`);
console.log(await response.json());
```

```python
import json
import os
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

query = urllib.parse.urlencode({"query": "carbon border tax 2026", "limit": 5})
request = urllib.request.Request(
    f"https://yep.com/api/v1/search?{query}",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['YEP_API_KEY']}"},
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
    print(json.load(response))
```

The response is a JSON object with ranked results under `results`. `GET` and `POST /api/v1/search` return the same envelope; `GET` always projects `url`, `title`, `description`, and `language`, while `POST` accepts `select` for other fields. `request_id` matches the `X-Request-ID` response header for support and diagnostics.

```json
{
  "request_id": "0b9f2c3e-6f1d-4c1a-9a43-2d6f1e0c8b7a",
  "duration_ms": 412,
  "select": ["url", "title", "description", "language"],
  "results": [
    {
      "rank": 1,
      "fields": {
        "url": "https://example.com/carbon-border-tax",
        "title": "Carbon border adjustment mechanisms",
        "description": "A guide to carbon border taxes and their implementation.",
        "language": "en"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Continue

Read [Authentication](/en/docs/authentication/) before deploying an HTTP integration, [choose the Search API or Agent API](/en/docs/agent/choose/), or [connect an MCP client](/en/docs/mcp/) without creating an API key.

---

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/authentication/ -->

# Authentication

Create, store, rotate, and send Yep API credentials safely.

## API keys

The public REST API uses an API key as a Bearer token. Create a key in the product and copy its secret when it is shown. Yep does not show the full secret again.

```http
Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
```

Keep keys in a secret manager or environment variable. Do not put a key in browser code, a URL, source control, logs, or documentation examples.

## Key lifecycle

Use a separate key for each application and environment so access can be revoked without interrupting unrelated workloads.

When rotating a key:

1. Create the replacement key.
2. Deploy the replacement to every instance.
3. Confirm requests succeed with the replacement.
4. Revoke the previous key.

## MCP authentication

The remote MCP server accepts OAuth only, not API keys. Start authentication from your MCP client and complete the authorization flow in the browser. Search tools require `search:read`. Model, query-builder, and agent tools require both `search:read` and `agent:run`; `agent:run` is never granted by itself.

Next, [integrate the Search API over HTTP](/en/docs/integrations/http/) or [choose an MCP client](/en/docs/mcp/).

---

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/service-accounts/ -->

# Service accounts

Create service accounts for automated workloads and manage their credentials.

## Exchange a service-account credential

Use a service account for an automated workload. Use a human API key for a member-operated integration, or MCP OAuth when an AI client acts with a member's approval.

Create the account in **Settings → Service accounts**, select only the permissions the workload needs, and create a credential. Move the returned `token_endpoint`, `client_id`, and `client_secret` directly into the workload's secret manager. The plaintext secret is present only in the creation response.

Set `YEP_TOKEN_ENDPOINT`, `YEP_CLIENT_ID`, and `YEP_CLIENT_SECRET`, then request an access token:

```curl
curl --request POST "$YEP_TOKEN_ENDPOINT" \
  --data-urlencode "client_id=$YEP_CLIENT_ID" \
  --data-urlencode "client_secret=$YEP_CLIENT_SECRET" \
  --data-urlencode "grant_type=client_credentials"
```

Never send the client secret to a Search API endpoint, browser code, URL, source-control repository, log, or another service account.

## Request a token in application code

```typescript
const body = new URLSearchParams({
  client_id: process.env.YEP_CLIENT_ID!,
  client_secret: process.env.YEP_CLIENT_SECRET!,
  grant_type: "client_credentials",
});
const response = await fetch(process.env.YEP_TOKEN_ENDPOINT!, { method: "POST", body });
if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Token endpoint returned ${response.status}`);
const token = await response.json();
```

```python
import json
import os
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

body = urllib.parse.urlencode({
    "client_id": os.environ["YEP_CLIENT_ID"],
    "client_secret": os.environ["YEP_CLIENT_SECRET"],
    "grant_type": "client_credentials",
}).encode()
request = urllib.request.Request(os.environ["YEP_TOKEN_ENDPOINT"], data=body, method="POST")
with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
    token = json.load(response)
```

The token response provides its lifetime. Cache the access token in workload memory, request a replacement before expiry, and ensure concurrent requests share one refresh. After an unexpected `401`, fetch one new token and retry once; repeated rejection requires operator action.

## Send the access token

Send the access token as the Bearer credential. Do not send the client secret.

```curl
curl --get "https://yep.com/api/v1/search" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "query=carbon border tax 2026"
```

## Set permissions and boundaries

Each access token is workspace-bound. The service-account permissions selected at creation must authorize the requested operation, and resource ownership boundaries still apply. Revoking the account invalidates credentials issued for that identity.

Use separate service accounts for workloads that need different permissions, ownership, limits, or revocation schedules. Do not share one identity across unrelated applications.

## Rotate without an outage

1. Create a replacement service account with the required permissions.
2. Recreate account-specific limits and move work owned by the previous identity.
3. Create and deploy the replacement credential.
4. Verify token exchange and one intended Yep request.
5. Revoke the previous service account.

If a credential may have leaked, revoke its service account before creating the replacement. Revocation is the boundary that invalidates all credentials for that service-account identity.

---

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/integrations/http/ -->

# HTTP integration

Integrate the Search API with stable request, response, and retry handling.

## Request shape

Send `GET https://yep.com/api/v1/search` with an API key in the `Authorization` header. Put `query`, `limit`, and `lang` in the URL query string using your HTTP library's URL encoder.

Use a connection timeout and an overall request deadline appropriate for your application. Keep the API key outside application logs.

## Response handling

Treat the response as successful only when the HTTP status is in the 2xx range. Decode the JSON body as an object, read ranked results from `results`, and preserve the `X-Request-ID` response header with your request telemetry.

Do not infer missing fields or replace an invalid response with defaults. A malformed successful response is an integration failure.

## Retries

Retry only requests that are safe for your workload. For `429`, wait at least the number of seconds in `Retry-After`. For `503` with `reason: "model_provider_overloaded"`, honor `Retry-After` when present; the typed `retry` recovery also says whether changing the selected model is allowed. For other temporary `502` or `503` responses, use capped exponential backoff with jitter.

Do not automatically retry `400`, `401`, `402`, or `403`; correct the request, credential, permissions, or account limit first.

## Verify the integration

Test a successful query, an invalid query, an invalid key, product rate limiting, provider throttling, and provider overload before production. Log the HTTP status, stable error reason, request ID, and agent session ID when present, but never the credential or raw sensitive diagnostics.

Use the [Search API reference](/en/docs/reference/search/) for the generated contract and [errors and limits](/en/docs/errors-and-limits/) for recovery guidance.

---

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/search/domains/ -->

# Search for domains

Find ranked domains when a page-level result set is too narrow.

## Send a domain search

Use domain search when each result should identify a site instead of one page from that site.

```curl
curl --request POST "https://yep.com/api/v1/search/domains" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "query": "independent climate policy research",
  "limit": 10,
  "select": [
    "domain",
    "domain_traffic"
  ],
  "filter": "@domain_traffic >= 1000"
}
JSON
```

The response contains ranked domain results, the normalized projection, request duration, and a request reference. Each result contains exactly the fields selected by the request.

## Choose page or domain results

- Use page search to retrieve URLs, titles, descriptions, page metadata, and passages.
- Use domain search to discover and compare sites related to a query.
- Do not group page-search results by hostname and treat that as domain ranking. Domain search is a separate ranked view.

Domain search uses the Search API permission, billing, spend limits, and rate limits. It has its own result limit and a narrower field view than page search.

## Filter and select fields

Write `filter` with the public filter language used by `POST /search`. The active domain view decides which fields and operators are legal. Use the generated [domain-search request schema](/en/docs/reference/search/post-search-domains/#schema-domainsearchpostrequest) instead of maintaining a separate field list.

An empty projection, duplicate field, page-only field, incompatible operator, or incorrectly typed value returns validation issues with paths. Correct every reported issue before retrying.

## Use the same operation through MCP

The MCP `search_domains` tool accepts the same typed request and returns the same structured result. Use the [MCP domain-search reference](/en/docs/mcp/tools/search-domains/) when an AI client should call it through OAuth.

Continue with the [domain-search API reference](/en/docs/reference/search/post-search-domains/) for response statuses and schemas.

---

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/errors-and-limits/ -->

# Errors, limits, and billing

Handle API failures, request limits, retries, and completed-request billing.

## Error responses

API failures use a stable JSON error body. Branch on the HTTP status and machine-readable `reason`, not the human-readable message. Include `X-Request-ID` when contacting support.

- `400` — inspect `validation` when present, correct every listed request field, then retry.
- `401` — provide a valid, active API key.
- `402` — review billing and spend limits before retrying.
- `403` — use a key with Search API permission.
- `429` — wait for `Retry-After`, then retry with backoff. Inspect `reason` to distinguish an account policy (`rate_limit_exceeded`) from provider throttling (`model_provider_rate_limited`).
- `503` with `model_provider_overloaded` — the selected model provider has no temporary capacity. Honor `Retry-After` when present, or select another allowed model when `recovery.can_change_model` is true.
- Other `502` or `503` responses — retry temporary service failures with capped backoff and jitter.

## Validation errors

A `400` response may include `validation`, the same bounded report returned by MCP at
`structuredContent.error.validation`:

```json
{
  "code": "invalid_request",
  "reason": "malformed_request",
  "message": "invalid request: request body violates the public contract",
  "recovery": null,
  "agent_session_id": null,
  "validation": {
    "contract": "SearchPostRequest",
    "issues": [
      {
        "code": "required",
        "path": "/query",
        "suggestion": "Add the required `query` field."
      }
    ],
    "truncated": false
  }
}
```

`contract` names the published request schema. Each issue has a stable `code`, an RFC 6901
`path`, and a `suggestion`. When `allowed_values` is present, use one of those exact JSON scalar
values. A root error uses an empty `path`.

Correct every listed issue before retrying. If `truncated` is `true`, validate the corrected
request again because the report omitted additional issues. Do not retry an unchanged rejected
request. Stop if the same output fails again, and use a small fixed repair ceiling for each
request. Validation errors are not transient, so backoff does not repair them.

## Result and request limits

`limit` accepts 1 through 50 results. The API has no pagination. Changing the limit can change ranking, so do not combine separate calls as pages of one result set.

Rate limits are enforced by the active account and key policy. The API returns `429` and `Retry-After` when a request should wait; this documentation does not publish a fixed numeric rate that could differ from the configured policy.

Provider throttling and overload use the same `reason` and `recovery` fields as product rate limits. `recovery.kind` is `retry`, `retry_after_ms` preserves the provider hint, and `recovery.can_change_model` tells an agent client whether selecting another allowed model is a valid recovery. Direct HTTP failures carry `Retry-After` as the [RFC 9110 retry header](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-10.2.3) in whole seconds. Responses with `429` are emitted with `Cache-Control: no-store`, preserving the [RFC 6585 caching requirement](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6585#section-4).

Every agent execution mints an `agent_session_id` before calling the model provider. A synchronous REST failure returns it in the error body; MCP returns the same structured error; and a background run keeps it in the accepted response and every polled status. A failed background status remains a successful status lookup (`200`) whose `error` contains the same provider `reason` and `recovery`. The session id is useful for status and support correlation, but it is not a credential.

## Billing

Balanced costs $4 per 1,000 completed requests. A failed search execution is not charged. Account spend limits can reject a request with `402` before execution.

The documentation console sends real API requests. Normal billing, spend limits, and rate limits apply.

## Recovery checklist

1. Record the HTTP status, `X-Request-ID`, and `agent_session_id` when present.
2. Read the stable error `reason`.
3. Correct non-retryable failures before sending another request.
4. Honor `Retry-After` and use jitter for retryable failures.

Return to the [HTTP integration guide](/en/docs/integrations/http/) or inspect the [generated API reference](/en/docs/reference/search/).

---

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/agent/choose/ -->

# Choose the Search API or Agent API

Choose ranked results or a model-written report for each workload.

## Run one search

Use the Search API when your application needs ranked pages that it will filter, rerank, or pass to its own model.

```curl
curl --get "https://yep.com/api/v1/search" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'query=carbon border tax 2026'
```

The Search API is plain search: one query enters, ranked results return, and the request ends. Use `GET` for a small query or `POST` when you need typed filters and an explicit result projection.

## Run one agent

Use the Agent API when the output should be a sourced report rather than a result list.

```curl
curl --request POST "https://yep.com/api/v1/agent" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "mode": "light",
  "input": "Summarize the latest carbon border tax guidance.",
  "model": {
    "provider": "openrouter",
    "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"
  },
  "background": false
}
JSON
```

The agent searches the same index, decides which evidence to inspect, and writes a report with sources. `light` is the shorter evidence pass. `deep` is the longer research pass. Set `background` when the caller should receive polling credentials instead of holding one connection open.

## Choose by output

- Choose the Search API when your code owns ranking, extraction, prompting, and presentation.
- Choose the Agent API when Yep should search, inspect evidence, and assemble the report.
- Choose domain search when the items you need are sites rather than pages.
- Choose the query builder when a model should construct a typed Search API request without executing it.

Search API requests use search permission and Search API billing. Agent runs and query-builder calls use agent permission, a stored model provider key, and Agent API billing. The provider also charges model usage to that provider key. Read [errors, limits, and billing](/en/docs/errors-and-limits/) before deploying either path.

## Use REST or MCP

REST exposes the same operations as stable HTTP contracts. MCP exposes search, domain search, model discovery, query building, and agent execution as typed tools through OAuth. Use REST when your application controls the calls. Use [MCP](/en/docs/mcp/) when an AI client should choose and call the tools.

Continue with [BYOK model setup](/en/docs/agent/byok/) or open the [Agent API reference](/en/docs/reference/agent/).

---

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/agent/byok/ -->

# Use your own model provider key

Connect a model provider key and select an allowlisted model for Agent API and MCP calls.

## List available models

List the current provider and model catalog before building a search request or starting an agent.

```curl
curl --request GET "https://yep.com/api/v1/models" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY"
```

The response is the source of truth for allowlisted provider and model identifiers, capabilities, current provider pricing, supported key scopes, and the signed-in setup URL. Do not copy a model identifier from an old request into a new integration without checking the catalog.

## Authorize BYOK operations

REST clients use an API key with both `search:read` and `agent:run`. MCP clients use OAuth only and request the same two scopes. Yep rejects `agent:run` without `search:read`, so an agent can always execute the search operations its program builds.

## Connect the provider key

1. Open the returned `setup_url` while signed in. The URL is derived from the configured product origin, so it remains correct outside production.
2. Choose personal scope for one member or workspace scope for authorized members of the workspace.
3. Submit an active inference key. Yep checks the key before saving it.
4. Send only the provider and model identifiers in Agent API or query-builder requests.

The public API and MCP tools never accept provider-key plaintext. Model-list responses expose safe provider metadata, not stored-key metadata. Keep the original provider key out of application requests, browser storage, source control, and logs.

## Understand the two billing relationships

The model provider charges inference usage to the connected provider key. Yep charges the completed Agent API operation under the applicable account and spend limits. BYOK changes whose provider account pays for inference; it does not remove Agent API billing.

Use the live model catalog for provider prices and the product pricing surface for Yep prices. Do not calculate either from values copied into documentation.

## Recover from key failures

If no usable key can run the selected model, the API returns a stable missing-key reason and a setup recovery URL. Open that URL, add or replace the key, then retry the original request. Correct every validation issue before retrying an invalid model reference.

For MCP, call `list_models` first and follow the same `setup_url`. Provider-key plaintext never passes through a tool argument.

Continue with [Search API or Agent API](/en/docs/agent/choose/) or inspect the [model catalog operation](/en/docs/reference/models/list-models/).

---

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/mcp/ -->

# Connect an MCP client

Choose a client and connect it to the Yep search tool with OAuth.

## Server endpoint

Yep exposes one remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.

```text
https://yep.com/api/v1/mcp
```

## Authentication

The server uses OAuth only. Request search:read for search tools. Model, query-builder, and agent tools require both search:read and agent:run. Your client opens the authorization flow and stores the resulting credentials.

## Set up BYOK agent tools

Call list_models to choose an allowlisted provider and model. Store the provider key in Yep at the returned setup_url; provider-key plaintext is never accepted by an MCP tool. If setup is missing, the tool returns provider_key_missing with the same setup URL in structuredContent.

## Recover from tool errors

Tool execution failures set isError to true. When error.validation is present, correct every RFC 6901 issue before retrying and do not repeat unchanged input.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request",
    "reason": "malformed_request",
    "message": "invalid request: request body violates the public contract",
    "recovery": null,
    "agent_session_id": null,
    "validation": {
      "contract": "SearchPostRequest",
      "issues": [
        {
          "code": "required",
          "path": "/query",
          "suggestion": "Add the required `query` field."
        }
      ],
      "truncated": false
    }
  },
  "request_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

## Choose a client

### Codex

Add the server to your user or trusted-project config, then start the OAuth flow.

#### Configure Codex

```toml
[mcp_servers.yep]
url = "https://yep.com/api/v1/mcp"
auth = "oauth"
```

#### Authenticate

Start the OAuth flow from the client, then approve access in the browser.

```sh
codex mcp login yep
```

#### Verify the connection

Ask the client to search the web. The client should discover the search tool and open OAuth if authorization is still required.

[Codex MCP documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp.md)

### Claude Code

Add the remote HTTP server at user scope, then authenticate it from the command line.

#### Configure Claude Code

```sh
claude mcp add --transport http yep --scope user https://yep.com/api/v1/mcp
claude mcp login yep
```

#### Verify the connection

Ask the client to search the web. The client should discover the search tool and open OAuth if authorization is still required.

[Claude Code MCP documentation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp)

### Claude Desktop

Open Settings, choose Connectors, add a custom connector with the MCP URL, then connect it.

#### Configure Claude Desktop

```text
https://yep.com/api/v1/mcp
```

#### Verify the connection

Ask the client to search the web. The client should discover the search tool and open OAuth if authorization is still required.

[Claude Desktop MCP documentation](https://claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/remote-mcp)

### Cursor

Add the remote server to the global or project MCP configuration, then connect it from MCP settings.

#### Configure Cursor

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "yep": {
      "url": "https://yep.com/api/v1/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

#### Verify the connection

Ask the client to search the web. The client should discover the search tool and open OAuth if authorization is still required.

[Cursor MCP documentation](https://docs.cursor.com/context/model-context-protocol)

### VS Code

Add the remote HTTP server to your user or workspace MCP configuration, then start it and complete authentication.

#### Configure VS Code

```json
{
  "servers": {
    "yep": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://yep.com/api/v1/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

#### Verify the connection

Ask the client to search the web. The client should discover the search tool and open OAuth if authorization is still required.

[VS Code MCP documentation](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agents/reference/mcp-configuration)

# MCP search tool

Input, output, and behavior generated from the advertised MCP tool contract.

## Overview

Search Yep with the complete typed public POST search contract and return projected ranked results.

Use the typed search tools for web retrieval. Use list_models before BYOK query-builder or agent calls, and configure a provider key at the returned setup_url when requested. When a tool error's structured content includes error.validation, correct every listed RFC 6901 issue before retrying and never repeat an unchanged rejected input.

## Input schema

*MCP search tool input*

| Name | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| query | Yes | string | Non-empty search text. | min length: 1; max length: 512 |
| limit | No | integer \| null | Maximum result count; defaults to 20 at the product boundary. | min: 1; max: 50 |
| lang | No | string \| null | Optional two-letter lowercase language code. | pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$ |
| coverage | No | SearchCoverage \| null | Search breadth; omission preserves balanced search. |  |
| ranking | No | SearchRanking \| null | Ranking focus; omission preserves balanced search. |  |
| select | No | SearchResultField[] | Response projection; omission selects the stable summary fields. | default: url,title,description,language; min items: 1 |
| filter | No | string \| null | Optional eligibility filter in the public filter language. | min length: 1; max length: 65536 |
| max_results_per_domain | No | integer \| null | Optional maximum number of results from one registrable domain. | min: 1; max: 10 |

## Output schema

Returns structured JSON from the shared public API service.

*MCP search tool output fields*

| Name | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| request_id | Yes | string | Public request correlation identifier. |
| duration_ms | Yes | integer | End-to-end duration in milliseconds. |
| select | Yes | SearchResultField[] | Echoed normalized projection. |
| results | Yes | ProjectedPageResult[] | Ranked projected results. |

## Tool errors

Tool execution failures set isError to true. When error.validation is present, correct every RFC 6901 issue before retrying and do not repeat unchanged input.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request",
    "reason": "malformed_request",
    "message": "invalid request: request body violates the public contract",
    "recovery": null,
    "agent_session_id": null,
    "validation": {
      "contract": "SearchPostRequest",
      "issues": [
        {
          "code": "required",
          "path": "/query",
          "suggestion": "Add the required `query` field."
        }
      ],
      "truncated": false
    }
  },
  "request_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

## Behavior

This tool is read-only, non-destructive, and idempotent.

---

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/mcp/tools/search-domains/ -->

# MCP domain search tool

Input, output, and behavior generated from the advertised MCP tool contract.

## Overview

Search Yep domains with the complete typed public domain-search contract.

Use the typed search tools for web retrieval. Use list_models before BYOK query-builder or agent calls, and configure a provider key at the returned setup_url when requested. When a tool error's structured content includes error.validation, correct every listed RFC 6901 issue before retrying and never repeat an unchanged rejected input.

## Input schema

*MCP domain search tool input*

| Name | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| query | Yes | string | Non-empty search text. | min length: 1; max length: 512 |
| limit | No | integer \| null | Maximum result count; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. | min: 1; max: 100 |
| select | Yes | SearchResultField[] | Required non-empty response projection. | min items: 1 |
| filter | No | string \| null | Optional eligibility filter in the public filter language. | min length: 1; max length: 65536 |

## Output schema

Returns structured JSON from the shared public API service.

*MCP domain search tool output fields*

| Name | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| request_id | Yes | string | Public request correlation identifier. |
| duration_ms | Yes | integer | End-to-end duration in milliseconds. |
| select | Yes | SearchResultField[] | Echoed normalized projection. |
| results | Yes | ProjectedDomainResult[] | Ranked projected domains. |

## Tool errors

Tool execution failures set isError to true. When error.validation is present, correct every RFC 6901 issue before retrying and do not repeat unchanged input.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request",
    "reason": "malformed_request",
    "message": "invalid request: request body violates the public contract",
    "recovery": null,
    "agent_session_id": null,
    "validation": {
      "contract": "SearchPostRequest",
      "issues": [
        {
          "code": "required",
          "path": "/query",
          "suggestion": "Add the required `query` field."
        }
      ],
      "truncated": false
    }
  },
  "request_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

## Behavior

This tool is read-only, non-destructive, and idempotent.

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/mcp/tools/build-search-request/ -->

# MCP query builder tool

Build a typed search request with a stored BYOK model.

## Overview

Build a complete typed Yep search request from natural language with a stored BYOK model. This does not execute search and bills one Agent API run after a valid build.

Use the typed search tools for web retrieval. Use list_models before BYOK query-builder or agent calls, and configure a provider key at the returned setup_url when requested. When a tool error's structured content includes error.validation, correct every listed RFC 6901 issue before retrying and never repeat an unchanged rejected input.

## Input schema

*MCP query builder tool input*

| Name | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| instruction | Yes | string | Natural-language search goal. | min length: 1; max length: 4096 |
| current_request | No | SearchPostRequest \| null | Optional request whose useful constraints should be preserved. |  |
| model | Yes | AgentModelRef | Exact allowlisted BYOK model. |  |

## Output schema

Returns structured JSON from the shared public API service.

*MCP query builder tool output fields*

| Name | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| request | Yes | SearchPostRequest | Complete public search request. |
| canonical_filter | No | string \| null | Canonical text form of `request.filter`, when present. |
| request_id | Yes | string | Billing and support correlation identifier. |

## Tool errors

Tool execution failures set isError to true. When error.validation is present, correct every RFC 6901 issue before retrying and do not repeat unchanged input.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request",
    "reason": "malformed_request",
    "message": "invalid request: request body violates the public contract",
    "recovery": null,
    "agent_session_id": null,
    "validation": {
      "contract": "SearchPostRequest",
      "issues": [
        {
          "code": "required",
          "path": "/query",
          "suggestion": "Add the required `query` field."
        }
      ],
      "truncated": false
    }
  },
  "request_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

## Behavior

This tool is state-changing or billable, non-destructive, and not idempotent.

# MCP agent status tool

Poll a background agent run with its response-only session proof.

## Overview

Read a background agent run using the id and one-time session proof returned by run_agent.

Use the typed search tools for web retrieval. Use list_models before BYOK query-builder or agent calls, and configure a provider key at the returned setup_url when requested. When a tool error's structured content includes error.validation, correct every listed RFC 6901 issue before retrying and never repeat an unchanged rejected input.

## Input schema

*MCP agent status tool input*

| Name | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | Yes | string | See the public contract for this field. |  |
| session_secret | Yes | string | See the public contract for this field. |  |

## Output schema

Returns structured JSON from the shared public API service.

*MCP agent status tool output fields*

| Name | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| agent_session_id | Yes | string | Non-secret execution correlation id from the signed runtime session. |
| state | Yes | AgentRuntimeState | Closed runtime lifecycle state. |
| program_digest | Yes | string | Pinned semantic program digest. |
| output | Yes | RequiredNullableSchema | Present only for a successful terminal run. |
| error | Yes | RequiredNullableSchema2 | Present only for a failed terminal run. |
| usage | Yes | UsageReport | Provider usage accumulated so far. |

Tool execution failures set isError to true. When error.validation is present, correct every RFC 6901 issue before retrying and do not repeat unchanged input.

```json
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request",
    "reason": "malformed_request",

        }

  "request_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/changelog/ -->

# Changelog

Material changes to Yep developer APIs, MCP, and documentation.

## 2026-10-06

**Breaking:** `GET /api/v1/search` now returns the same JSON envelope as `POST /api/v1/search` — `{request_id, duration_ms, select, results: [{rank, fields}]}` — instead of a bare array. The projected fields are unchanged (`url`, `title`, `description`, `language`); read them from `results[].fields`. Queries containing control characters are now rejected with `400`, matching `POST`.

## 2026-08-07

Published the Agent API, model catalog, and query builder as shared REST and MCP capabilities. MCP now accepts OAuth only, and every agent-capable credential requires `search:read` together with `agent:run`. Added the BYOK setup guide and configured recovery links for missing provider keys.

Added end-to-end model-provider capacity errors for BYOK agent workflows. Direct provider throttling returns `429` with `model_provider_rate_limited`; direct temporary provider capacity exhaustion returns `503` with `model_provider_overloaded`. Background status errors carry the same reason and typed retry recovery while the status lookup remains `200`. The existing standards-compatible `Retry-After` path is preserved, and agent errors expose the non-secret `agent_session_id` for correlation.

## 2026-08-03

Launched the developer portal with a runnable Search API quickstart, generated OpenAPI reference, focused MCP client guides, raw Markdown pages, documentation search data, and LLM discovery files.

Added the authenticated API console. Console requests use the public Search API and follow normal billing, spend-limit, and rate-limit behavior.

## Changelog policy

This log starts with the developer portal launch. It records material public contract, integration, and documentation changes from this date forward; it does not reconstruct earlier releases.

The generated [Search API reference](/en/docs/reference/search/) remains the source of truth for the current HTTP contract.

---

# API reference

Base URL, authentication, and every public API operation.

## Connection

*API connection*

| Name | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Base URL | https://yep.com/api |
| Authentication | Bearer token |
| Specification | 3.1.0 |

## Search

Explore the search operations.

- `GET` [`/v1/search`](/en/docs/reference/search/get-search/) — Search the web index.
- `POST` [`/v1/search`](/en/docs/reference/search/post-search/) — Search with typed filters and result projection.
- `POST` [`/v1/search/ask`](/en/docs/reference/search/post-search-ask/) — Search from a natural-language question.
- `POST` [`/v1/search/domains`](/en/docs/reference/search/post-search-domains/) — Find domains with typed filters and result projection.

## Agent

Explore the agent operations.

- `POST` [`/v1/agent`](/en/docs/reference/agent/run-agent/) — Run an agent.
- `GET` [`/v1/agent/{id}`](/en/docs/reference/agent/get-agent-run/) — Get an agent run.

## Query builder

Explore the query builder operations.

- `POST` [`/v1/query-builder`](/en/docs/reference/query-builder/build-search-request/) — Build a typed search request from natural language.

## Models

Explore the models operations.

- `GET` [`/v1/models`](/en/docs/reference/models/list-models/) — List models available to BYOK operations.

## Management

Explore the management operations.

- `POST` [`/v1/api-keys`](/en/docs/reference/api-keys/create-api-key/) — Create an API key.
- `DELETE` [`/v1/api-keys/{id}`](/en/docs/reference/api-keys/revoke-api-key/) — Revoke an API key.

# Run an agent

Runs the light or deep agent with the customer's configured provider key. Set background to return polling credentials immediately.

## POST /v1/agent

## Request body

JSON body: AgentRequest

```curl
curl --request POST "https://yep.com/api/v1/agent" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "mode": "light",
  "input": "Summarize the latest carbon border tax guidance.",
  "model": {
    "provider": "openrouter",
    "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"
  },
  "background": false
}
JSON
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Validated agent result. | AgentRuntimeStatus |
| 202 | Background run accepted; the proof is present only in this response. | AgentRunCreated |
| 400 | Invalid request. | PublicApiError |
| 401 | Authentication required. | PublicApiError |
| 402 | Agent API funds or a spend limit rejected execution. | PublicApiError |
| 403 | The API key lacks agent permission. | PublicApiError |
| 409 | No stored provider key can run the selected model; recovery includes the setup URL. | PublicApiError |
| 429 | The request exceeded a rate boundary. | PublicApiError |
| 500 | The service could not safely complete the operation. | PublicApiError |
| 502 | The agent runtime returned an invalid response. | PublicApiError |
| 503 | The agent is temporarily unavailable. | PublicApiError |
| 504 | A synchronous run exceeded five minutes. | PublicApiError |

## Schemas

### AgentEntrypoint

Closed product-facing program entrypoints.

```json
[
  "light",
  "deep"
]
```

### AgentModelRef

One allowlisted inference provider and model identifier.

*AgentModelRef fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model | Yes | string | Provider-native model identifier. |  |
| provider | Yes | ProviderKeyProvider | Closed provider discriminator. |  |

### AgentRequest

One billed Agent API run.

*AgentRequest fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| background | No | boolean | Return immediately with polling credentials instead of awaiting the result. |  |
| input | Yes | string | Research request passed to the selected agent program. | min length: 1; max length: 20000 |
| mode | Yes | AgentEntrypoint | Execution depth for this run. |  |
| model | Yes | AgentModelRef | Exact allowlisted provider/model pair selected for this run. |  |

### AgentRunCreated

Background Agent API run accepted for polling.

*AgentRunCreated fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | Yes | string | Non-secret run locator used for status polling. |  |
| session_secret | Yes | string | Independent proof required together with the API key. |  |

### AgentRuntimeFailure

Product-facing agent failure after runtime metadata has crossed the policy boundary.

*AgentRuntimeFailure fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| class | Yes | AgentRuntimeFailureClass | Stable runtime failure class. |  |
| message | Yes | string | Sanitized target-owned explanation. |  |
| reason | Yes | null \| ErrorReason |  |  |
| recovery | Yes | null \| ErrorRecovery |  |  |

### AgentRuntimeFailureClass

Closed portable runtime failure classes.

```json
[
  "rate_limited",
  "timeout",
  "transport",
  "invalid_output",
  "rejected",
  "internal"
]
```

### AgentRuntimeState

Portable runtime lifecycle values.

```json
[
  "queued",
  "running",
  "succeeded",
  "failed"
]
```

### AgentRuntimeStatus

Product-facing terminal or in-progress status returned by agent APIs.

*AgentRuntimeStatus fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| agent_session_id | Yes | string | Non-secret execution correlation id from the signed runtime session. |  |
| error | Yes | null \| AgentRuntimeFailure |  |  |
| output | Yes | null \| Report |  |  |
| program_digest | Yes | string | Pinned semantic program digest. |  |
| state | Yes | AgentRuntimeState | Closed runtime lifecycle state. |  |
| usage | Yes | UsageReport | Provider usage accumulated so far. |  |

### ErrorCode

Machine-readable product API failure.

```json
[
  "unauthenticated",
  "forbidden",
  "invalid_request",
  "not_found",
  "conflict",
  "payment_required",
  "too_many_requests",
  "upstream",
  "internal"
]
```

### ErrorReason

Stable product API failure reason.

```json
[
  "malformed_request",
  "authentication_required",
  "reauthentication_required",
  "permission_denied",
  "api_key_name_invalid",
  "spend_policy_invalid",
  "rate_policy_invalid",
  "provider_key_invalid",
  "provider_key_missing",
  "agent_model_not_allowed",
  "resource_not_found",
  "state_conflict",
  "insufficient_funds",
  "spend_limit_exceeded",
  "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "model_provider_rate_limited",
  "model_provider_overloaded",
  "dependency_unavailable",
  "internal_failure"
]
```

### ErrorRecovery

Browser-safe recovery action selected by the authoritative product boundary.

*ErrorRecovery alternatives*

| Variant | Type |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | object |
| 2 | object |
| 3 | object |

### ProviderKeyProvider

Closed provider set exposed to product clients.

```json
[
  "openrouter"
]
```

### PublicApiError

Stable public error envelope for APIs whose reason vocabulary is extensible.

*PublicApiError fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| agent_session_id | No | string \| null | Agent execution correlation id, present after an invocation is admitted. |  |
| code | Yes | ErrorCode | Closed status category suitable for program control flow. |  |
| message | Yes | string | Safe diagnostic intended for operators, not program branching. |  |
| reason | Yes | string | Extensible machine-readable detail; clients must accept unknown values. |  |
| recovery | No | null \| ErrorRecovery |  |  |
| validation | No | null \| ValidationReport |  |  |

### Report

### UsageReport

### ValidationIssue

One actionable, privacy-safe contract violation.

*ValidationIssue fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| allowed_values | No | array \| null |  | max items: 16 |
| code | Yes | string | Stable, extensible machine-readable category. | max length: 64 |
| path | Yes | string | RFC 6901 pointer to the rejected location; empty means the root value. | max length: 1024 |
| suggestion | Yes | string | Code-owned instruction for correcting the request. | max length: 512 |

### ValidationReport

Bounded validation feedback shared by model, REST, and MCP boundaries.

*ValidationReport fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| contract | Yes | string | Stable contract name, normally the published schema component name. | max length: 128 |
| issues | Yes | ValidationIssue[] | At most eight deterministic violations. Correct every issue before retrying. | max items: 8 |
| truncated | Yes | boolean | Whether more violations were omitted; retry after correcting the listed issues. |  |

# Get an agent run

Reads the current or terminal status of one authenticated background run.

## GET /v1/agent/{id}

## Parameters

*Request parameters*

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | path | Yes | string | Agent-session UUID returned at creation. |
| x-agent-session | header | Yes | string | Session proof present only in the creation response. |

```curl
curl --request GET "https://yep.com/api/v1/agent/$YEP_AGENT_SESSION_ID" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --header "x-agent-session: $YEP_AGENT_SESSION_SECRET"
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Current or terminal agent-session status. | AgentRuntimeStatus |
| 400 | Invalid request. | PublicApiError |
| 401 | API-key or session-proof authentication failed. | PublicApiError |
| 403 | The API key lacks agent permission. | PublicApiError |
| 404 | The session does not exist in the caller's scope. | PublicApiError |
| 429 | The request exceeded a rate boundary. | PublicApiError |
| 500 | The service could not safely complete the operation. | PublicApiError |
| 502 | The agent runtime returned an invalid response. | PublicApiError |
| 503 | The agent is temporarily unavailable. | PublicApiError |

| issues | Yes | ValidationIssue[] | At most eight deterministic violations. Correct every issue before retrying. | max items: 8 |
| truncated | Yes | boolean | Whether more violations were omitted; retry after correcting the listed issues. |  |

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/reference/query-builder/build-search-request/ -->

# Build a typed search request from natural language

Uses the selected allowlisted model and stored BYOK provider key. A successful validated build is billed as one Agent API run and does not execute search.

## POST /v1/query-builder

## Request body

JSON body: QueryBuilderRequest

```curl
curl --request POST "https://yep.com/api/v1/query-builder" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "instruction": "Find independent climate policy research with meaningful traffic.",
  "model": {
    "provider": "openrouter",
    "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"
  }
}
JSON
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Validated public search request. | QueryBuilderResponse |
| 400 | Invalid request. | PublicApiError |
| 401 | Authentication required. | PublicApiError |
| 402 | Agent API funds or a spend limit rejected execution. | PublicApiError |
| 403 | The API key lacks agent permission. | PublicApiError |
| 409 | No stored provider key can run the selected model; recovery includes the setup URL. | PublicApiError |
| 429 | The request exceeded a rate boundary. | PublicApiError |
| 500 | The service could not safely complete the operation. | PublicApiError |
| 502 | The model returned an invalid request. | PublicApiError |
| 503 | Inference is temporarily unavailable. | PublicApiError |

## Schemas

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |

| provider | Yes | ProviderKeyProvider | Closed provider discriminator. |  |

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/reference/models/list-models/ -->

# List models available to BYOK operations

Returns the Git-owned provider/model allowlist, verified provider pricing, capabilities, and setup links. Stored-key metadata is never returned.

## GET /v1/models

```curl
curl --request GET "https://yep.com/api/v1/models" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY"
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Allowlisted BYOK model catalog. | PublicAgentModelCatalog |
| 401 | Authentication required. | PublicApiError |
| 403 | The API key lacks agent permission. | PublicApiError |
| 429 | The request exceeded a rate boundary. | PublicApiError |
| 500 | The service could not safely complete the operation. | PublicApiError |
| 503 | Verified model pricing is unavailable. | PublicApiError |

## Schemas

### AgentModelPricing

Exact current `OpenRouter` list price displayed beside a model choice.

*AgentModelPricing fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| output_usd_per_million_tokens | No | string \| null | Output price in USD per million tokens; absent for variable-price routing. |  |
| request_usd | No | string \| null | Optional fixed USD price charged for one request. |  |

# Create an API key

Creates a scoped credential and returns its secret once.

## POST /v1/api-keys

## Request body

JSON body: PublicCreateApiKeyRequest

```curl
curl --request POST "https://yep.com/api/v1/api-keys" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "name": "string",
  "permissions": [
    "search-read"
  ]
}
JSON
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Key created; the secret is present only in this response. | PublicCreatedApiKey |
| 400 | Invalid request. | PublicApiError |
| 401 | Authentication required. | PublicApiError |
| 403 | Requested permissions exceed current authority. | PublicApiError |
| 409 | The account is unavailable or its active-key quota is exhausted. | PublicApiError |

## Schemas

### ErrorCode

Machine-readable product API failure.

```json
[
  "unauthenticated",
  "forbidden",
  "invalid_request",
  "not_found",
  "conflict",
  "payment_required",
  "too_many_requests",
  "upstream",
  "internal"
]
```

# Revoke an API key

Permanently revokes one credential owned by the authenticated identity.

## DELETE /v1/api-keys/{id}

## Parameters

*Request parameters*

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | path | Yes | string | Credential UUID returned at creation. |

```curl
curl --request DELETE "https://yep.com/api/v1/api-keys/$YEP_AGENT_SESSION_ID" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY"
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Key revoked. | object |
| 401 | Authentication required. | PublicApiError |
| 403 | The API key lacks key-management permission. | PublicApiError |
| 404 | Key is absent or owned by another identity. | PublicApiError |

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/reference/search/get-search/ -->

# Search the web index

Returns ranked web results in the same envelope as `POST /api/v1/search`, projected to url, title, description, and language. The result cap is 50 and the API does not paginate.

## GET /v1/search

## Parameters

*Request parameters*

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| query | query | Yes | string | Non-empty search text. |
| limit | query | No | integer | Maximum returned results. |
| lang | query | No | string | Optional two-letter lowercase language code. |
| coverage | query | No | SearchCoverage | Search breadth; omission preserves balanced search. |
| ranking | query | No | SearchRanking | Ranking focus; omission preserves balanced search. |

```curl
curl --get "https://yep.com/api/v1/search" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'query=carbon border tax 2026'
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Ranked projected search results | SearchPostResponse |
| 400 | The query violated the public contract | SearchV1Error |
| 401 | A valid API key is required | SearchV1Error |
| 402 | Billing or a spend limit rejected execution | SearchV1Error |
| 403 | The API key lacks search permission | SearchV1Error |
| 429 | A rate limit rejected execution | SearchV1Error |
| 500 | The service could not safely complete the request | SearchV1Error |
| 502 | The search request could not be completed | SearchV1Error |
| 503 | Search is temporarily unavailable | SearchV1Error |

## Schemas

### ErrorCode

Machine-readable product API failure.

```json
[
  "unauthenticated",
  "forbidden",
  "invalid_request",
  "not_found",
  "conflict",
  "payment_required",
  "too_many_requests",
  "upstream",
  "internal"
]
```

### ErrorRecovery

Browser-safe recovery action selected by the authoritative product boundary.

*ErrorRecovery alternatives*

| Variant | Type |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | object |
| 2 | object |
| 3 | object |

### PageResultFields

Optional nullable projected fields. Each property is omitted when not selected, `null` when selected but unavailable, or carries its typed value.

*PageResultFields fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| anchor | No | null \| string | Aggregated inbound anchor text. |  |
| author | No | null \| string | Page author. |  |
| categories | No | null \| object[] | Scored taxonomy categories. |  |
| content_angle | No | null \| string | Classified content angle. |  |
| description | No | null \| string | Result description. |  |
| document_intent | No | null \| string | Classified document intent. |  |
| domain | No | null \| string | Registrable or host domain. |  |
| domain_rating | No | null \| number | Domain rating. |  |
| domain_refdomains | No | null \| integer | Domain referring-domain count. |  |
| domain_traffic | No | null \| integer | Estimated domain traffic. |  |
| first_seen | No | null \| string | First-seen timestamp. |  |
| highlights | No | null \| string[] | Up to three query-relevant passages. |  |
| language | No | null \| string | Document language. |  |
| location | No | null \| string | Geographic location code. |  |
| page_type | No | null \| string | Page content type. |  |
| publish_time | No | null \| string | Published timestamp. |  |
| refclass_c | No | null \| integer | Refclass-C metric. |  |
| refdomains | No | null \| integer | Referring-domain count. |  |
| republished | No | null \| boolean | Whether the document was republished. |  |
| rule_type | No | null \| string | Applied rule type. |  |
| site_name | No | null \| string | Site display name. |  |
| title | No | null \| string | Page title. |  |
| traffic | No | null \| integer | Estimated URL traffic. |  |
| url | No | null \| string | Canonical page URL. |  |
| url_rating | No | null \| number | URL rating. |  |
| word_count | No | null \| integer | Visible word count. |  |

*ProjectedPageResult fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fields | Yes | PageResultFields | Exactly the requested fields. |  |

```json
  "refclass_c",

  "rule_type",
  "document_intent",
  "content_angle",
  "republished",
  "highlights"
]
```

### SearchV1Error

Search v1's original closed error envelope.

*SearchV1Error fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| agent_session_id | No | string \| null | Always absent for search; retained because runtime errors use one envelope. |  |
| code | Yes | ErrorCode | Closed status category. |  |
| message | Yes | string | Safe operator diagnostic. |  |
| reason | Yes | SearchV1ErrorReason | Closed Search v1 reason. |  |
| recovery | No | null \| ErrorRecovery |  |  |
| validation | No | null \| ValidationReport |  |  |

### SearchV1ErrorReason

Closed failure-reason vocabulary retained for the published Search v1 contract.

```json
[
  "malformed_request",
  "authentication_required",
  "permission_denied",
  "api_key_name_invalid",
  "spend_policy_invalid",
  "rate_policy_invalid",
  "resource_not_found",
  "state_conflict",
  "insufficient_funds",
  "spend_limit_exceeded",
  "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "dependency_unavailable",
  "internal_failure"
]
```

### ValidationIssue

One actionable, privacy-safe contract violation.

*ValidationIssue fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| allowed_values | No | array \| null |  | max items: 16 |
| code | Yes | string | Stable, extensible machine-readable category. | max length: 64 |
| path | Yes | string | RFC 6901 pointer to the rejected location; empty means the root value. | max length: 1024 |
| suggestion | Yes | string | Code-owned instruction for correcting the request. | max length: 512 |

### ValidationReport

Bounded validation feedback shared by model, REST, and MCP boundaries.

*ValidationReport fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| contract | Yes | string | Stable contract name, normally the published schema component name. | max length: 128 |
| issues | Yes | ValidationIssue[] | At most eight deterministic violations. Correct every issue before retrying. | max items: 8 |
| truncated | Yes | boolean | Whether more violations were omitted; retry after correcting the listed issues. |  |

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/reference/search/post-search/ -->

# Search with typed filters and result projection

Returns ranked web results using the shared typed filter and projection contract.

## POST /v1/search

## Request body

JSON body: SearchPostRequest

```search-request
post-search
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Ranked projected search results | SearchPostResponse |
| 400 | The request violated the public contract | SearchV1Error |
| 401 | A valid API key is required | SearchV1Error |
| 402 | Billing or a spend limit rejected execution | SearchV1Error |
| 403 | The API key lacks search permission | SearchV1Error |
| 429 | A rate limit rejected execution | SearchV1Error |
| 502 | The search request could not be completed | SearchV1Error |
| 503 | Search is temporarily unavailable | SearchV1Error |

## Schemas

### ErrorCode

Machine-readable product API failure.

```json
[
  "unauthenticated",
  "forbidden",
  "invalid_request",
  "not_found",
  "conflict",
  "payment_required",
  "too_many_requests",
  "upstream",
  "internal"
]
```

### ErrorRecovery

Browser-safe recovery action selected by the authoritative product boundary.

*ErrorRecovery alternatives*

| Variant | Type |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | object |
| 2 | object |
| 3 | object |

### PageResultFields

Optional nullable projected fields. Each property is omitted when not selected, `null` when selected but unavailable, or carries its typed value.

*PageResultFields fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| anchor | No | null \| string | Aggregated inbound anchor text. |  |
| author | No | null \| string | Page author. |  |
| categories | No | null \| object[] | Scored taxonomy categories. |  |
| content_angle | No | null \| string | Classified content angle. |  |
| description | No | null \| string | Result description. |  |
| document_intent | No | null \| string | Classified document intent. |  |
| domain | No | null \| string | Registrable or host domain. |  |
| domain_rating | No | null \| number | Domain rating. |  |
| domain_refdomains | No | null \| integer | Domain referring-domain count. |  |
| domain_traffic | No | null \| integer | Estimated domain traffic. |  |
| first_seen | No | null \| string | First-seen timestamp. |  |
| highlights | No | null \| string[] | Up to three query-relevant passages. |  |
| language | No | null \| string | Document language. |  |
| location | No | null \| string | Geographic location code. |  |
| page_type | No | null \| string | Page content type. |  |
| publish_time | No | null \| string | Published timestamp. |  |
| refclass_c | No | null \| integer | Refclass-C metric. |  |
| refdomains | No | null \| integer | Referring-domain count. |  |
| republished | No | null \| boolean | Whether the document was republished. |  |
| rule_type | No | null \| string | Applied rule type. |  |
| site_name | No | null \| string | Site display name. |  |
| title | No | null \| string | Page title. |  |
| traffic | No | null \| integer | Estimated URL traffic. |  |
| url | No | null \| string | Canonical page URL. |  |
| url_rating | No | null \| number | URL rating. |  |
| word_count | No | null \| integer | Visible word count. |  |

### ProjectedPageResult

One ranked projected result.

*ProjectedPageResult fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fields | Yes | PageResultFields | Exactly the requested fields. |  |
| rank | Yes | integer | One-based result rank. | min: 1 |

### SearchCoverage

How broad the search should be.

```json
[
  "balanced",
  "high",
  "maximum"
]
```

### SearchPostRequest

Public POST search request.

*SearchPostRequest fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| coverage | No | null \| SearchCoverage |  |  |
| filter | No | string \| null | Optional eligibility filter in the public filter language. | min length: 1; max length: 65536 |
| lang | No | string \| null | Optional two-letter lowercase language code. | pattern: ^[a-z]{2}$ |
| limit | No | integer \| null | Maximum result count; defaults to 20 at the product boundary. | min: 1; max: 50 |
| max_results_per_domain | No | integer \| null | Optional maximum number of results from one registrable domain. | min: 1; max: 10 |
| query | Yes | string | Non-empty search text. | min length: 1; max length: 512 |
| ranking | No | null \| SearchRanking |  |  |
| select | No | SearchResultField[] | Response projection; omission selects the stable summary fields. | min items: 1 |

### SearchPostResponse

Public POST search response.

*SearchPostResponse fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| duration_ms | Yes | integer | End-to-end duration in milliseconds. | min: 0 |
| request_id | Yes | string | Public request correlation identifier. |  |
| results | Yes | ProjectedPageResult[] | Ranked projected results. |  |
| select | Yes | SearchResultField[] | Echoed normalized projection. |  |

```json
  "precision",

  "content_gap"
]
```

<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/reference/search/post-search-ask/ -->

# Search from a natural-language question

Builds a typed search request with an optional allowlisted BYOK model or the catalog default, then executes it through the standard search path. A successful build and search are billed as one Agent API run and one Search API request.

## POST /v1/search/ask

## Request body

JSON body: AskSearchRequest

```curl
curl --request POST "https://yep.com/api/v1/search/ask" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "question": "Which independent studies compare carbon border taxes in 2026?"
}
JSON
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Ranked projected search results | SearchPostResponse |
| 400 | The question violated the public contract | PublicApiError |
| 401 | A valid API key is required | PublicApiError |
| 402 | Billing or a spend limit rejected a stage | PublicApiError |
| 403 | The API key lacks agent or search permission | PublicApiError |
| 409 | No stored provider key can run the selected model | PublicApiError |
| 429 | A rate limit rejected a stage | PublicApiError |
| 500 | The service could not safely complete the operation | PublicApiError |
| 502 | The model or search service returned an invalid response | PublicApiError |
| 503 | Inference or search is temporarily unavailable | PublicApiError |

## Schemas

### AgentModelRef

One allowlisted inference provider and model identifier.

*AgentModelRef fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model | Yes | string | Provider-native model identifier. |  |
| provider | Yes | ProviderKeyProvider | Closed provider discriminator. |  |

### AskSearchRequest

Natural-language search request compiled by the query builder before execution.

*AskSearchRequest fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model | No | null \| AgentModelRef |  |  |
| question | Yes | string | Question or search goal to turn into a typed search request. | min length: 1; max length: 4096 |

### ErrorCode


<!-- https://yep.com/en/docs/reference/search/post-search-domains/ -->

# Find domains with typed filters and result projection

Returns ranked domains using the same filter and projection language as page search.

## POST /v1/search/domains

## Request body

JSON body: DomainSearchPostRequest

```curl
curl --request POST "https://yep.com/api/v1/search/domains" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $YEP_API_KEY" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "query": "independent climate policy research",
  "limit": 10,
  "select": [
    "domain",
    "domain_traffic"
  ],
  "filter": "@domain_traffic >= 1000"
}
JSON
```

## Responses

*Response statuses*

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Ranked projected domain results | DomainSearchPostResponse |
| 400 | The request violated the public contract | SearchV1Error |
| 401 | A valid API key is required | SearchV1Error |
| 402 | Billing or a spend limit rejected execution | SearchV1Error |
| 403 | The API key lacks search permission | SearchV1Error |
| 429 | A rate limit rejected execution | SearchV1Error |
| 502 | The search request could not be completed | SearchV1Error |
| 503 | Search is temporarily unavailable | SearchV1Error |

## Schemas

### DomainResultFields

Typed fields returned by domain search. Properties are omitted when not selected.

*DomainResultFields fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| domain | No | string | Registrable domain. |  |
| domain_traffic | No | null \| ProjectedValue_u64 |  |  |

### DomainSearchPostRequest

Public domain-search request. It deliberately reuses the page search
filter and projection vocabularies; the domain view limits both to
`domain` and `domain_traffic`.

*DomainSearchPostRequest fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| filter | No | string \| null | Optional eligibility filter in the public filter language. | min length: 1; max length: 65536 |
| limit | No | integer \| null | Maximum result count; defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. | min: 1; max: 100 |
| query | Yes | string | Non-empty search text. | min length: 1; max length: 512 |
| select | Yes | SearchResultField[] | Required non-empty response projection. | min items: 1 |

### DomainSearchPostResponse

Public domain-search response.

*DomainSearchPostResponse fields*

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| duration_ms | Yes | integer | End-to-end duration in milliseconds. | min: 0 |
| request_id | Yes | string | Public request correlation identifier. |  |
| results | Yes | ProjectedDomainResult[] | Ranked projected domains. |  |
| select | Yes | SearchResultField[] | Echoed normalized projection. |  |
